fields.description: What is locked and who holds it. Deleting a row force-releases the lock — the admin escape hatch for a crashed editing session.
fields.label: Lock

fields.description: The coded lock token, urn:uuid form. The document name IS the token; a client submits it in If/Lock-Token headers to use or release the lock.
fields.label: Token

fields.description: Decoded request path at LOCK time, echoed as DAV:lockroot in lock discovery.
fields.label: Lock Root

fields.description: The authenticated user who created the lock — the only one whose submitted token counts; a leaked token grants nothing to anyone else.
fields.label: Owner User

fields.description: The client-supplied DAV:owner element (often the editing app's contact hint), re-serialized through the hardened parser and echoed back in lock discovery.
fields.label: Owner XML

fields.description: How far the lock reaches and how long it lasts.
fields.label: Scope & Lifetime

fields.description: Exclusive blocks everyone else's writes; Shared coexists with other shared locks (RFC 4918 write locks).
fields.label: Scope

fields.description: 0 covers the resource itself (a folder's member list included); infinity covers the entire subtree.
fields.label: Depth

fields.description: Granted (clamped) duration; refreshed in place by Office-style LOCK refreshes.
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: When the lock lapses — expired rows stop blocking immediately and are purged lazily plus by the hourly sweep.
fields.label: Expires At
